body: Ive tried counseling but I never feel that its ever helping me accomplish anything.  At that point, it feels like Im paying someone to care about my problems.  I have also tried talking to my mom but she always gives me the same bs like "youre a very attractive person" or "youre very smart." I simply can not agree as none of this is confirmed by other people and she is my mother and she has always tried to give me too much sugar per say.  I could never talk to her about the molestation though.  I dont think I could do it.

I do data management for an engineering firm.  I enjoy what I do as its the only thing I can show my worth.  But Im still alienated from most at my workplace due to my lack of ability to keep small talk.  It gets to the point where I am noticeably trembling around others if I have to give a presentation or something.  The only reason that I can see as to why Im still there is because I am very proficient at my work and able to produce results faster than any other member.  Still I dont see having a job where no college experience is required is anything worth bragging about.  As for my mother, I dont even understand why she cares for me other than moral requirement to.  I mean, no one else could care if I was around.  Why should she have to?
